What if more than one item in my order is affected?
If more than one item or part in your shipment is affected, our warranty covers all of them! You can report all damaged items together in a single claim.
When you share your photos and order details, just let us know everything that was impacted so our support team can arrange for all the necessary replacement parts or resolutions at once.
Whenever you're ready, please share your order number and we'll be glad to help you get started.
